Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 10

“O Bharata, in the midst of the two armies, Hrishikesha, as if smiling, spoke these words to the despairing one.”

The near-smile is one of the Gita's most quoted details. Not mockery — the ease of someone who sees the whole situation while Arjuna sees only its weight. Note the setting: this happens between armies.
